errors.text_span: 每个语体对应一根竖直柱状条
errors.evidence: The chart shows two bars for each corpus type ('语体'), one for '男性' (male) and one for '女性' (female). The description incorrectly states there is only one bar per corpus type.

The description fails to mention the specific content of each subplot as indicated by their captions: subplot (a) shows data for '支配动词' (controlling verbs) and subplot (b) shows data for '承受动词' (affected verbs). It only gives a general description for both.
The description omits the crucial subdivision on the x-axis. Each corpus type ('语体') is broken down into '男性' (male) and '女性' (female), which is a primary variable in the chart.

When describing the left subplot (a), the description claims to see percentages like '95%' and '96%'. However, the percentages visible in subplot (a) are 54%, 50%, 47%, 72%, 92%, 74%, and 90%. The values 95% and 96% do not appear in subplot (a).

errors.text_span: 另有两根柱顶标注约 6735 和约 6739
errors.evidence: The actual values on the chart for the two highest bars in subplot (a) are 6783 and 6792. The approximations 6735 and 6739 are inaccurate by about 50 units each.
When describing the right subplot (b), the description reports a percentage of '约“95%”' for the highest bar. The actual value shown in the chart is '92%'.
